english.note: Use this when someone acts frantically or puts in extreme effort to get something done.
Use 搏命咁 when the intensity involves making a desperate, all-out effort.

examples.english: I furiously pedaled my bike and finally got to work on time.
examples.traditional: 我搏命咁踩單車，終於趕得切返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bok3 meng6 gam3 caai2 daan1 ce1 zung1 jyu1 gon2 dak1 cit3 faan1 gung1

examples.english: We worked ferociously hard and finally finished the report.
examples.traditional: 我哋搏命咁做，終於趕完份報告。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bok3 meng6 gam3 zou6 zung1 jyu1 gon2 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3
